integrity: An exact analytic proof based on nonnegative-square containment identities, monotonic scalar equations, and isotropic John contact measures is supplied. A dependency-free test program provides finite corroboration; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement requires 0<q<1, integer d>=2, and 0<=L<1+q; equal-radius, empty/tangent intersections and intersections of three or more balls are excluded. Historical-priority uncertainty remains despite full-text comparisons.
title: Dimension-dependent contact screening for John ellipsoids of unequal-ball lenses
